main.description: Public ATM membership tier for a creator membership program. This is the portable tier/access target; app-specific badges, layout, welcome messages, and private member content belong in sidecar records.

program.description: AT-URI identity of the parent money.atmosphere.membership.program. Programs are mutable display records and consumers resolve the current record by URI.

description.description: Public description of this tier. Do not include private URLs, member-only content, or customer-specific instructions.

benefits.description: Public benefit labels only. Access enforcement comes from active payment state, not this display list.

product.description: Optional money.atmosphere.product record with kind=membership for this tier.

defaultPrice.description: Optional CID-pinned strongRef to the current recurring money.atmosphere.price for this tier. The money path resolves and re-quotes through this ref; inline display fields are never settlement truth.

unitAmount.description: Display amount in the smallest unit of currency, matching the linked price when present.

currency.description: Lowercase 3–16-letter currency identifier. Fiat identifiers use ISO 4217 codes. Catalog values may be stored before a payment rail supports them; chargeability is enforced separately by the configured processor allowlist.

rank.description: Optional access rank within the program. Higher ranks may include lower-rank benefits when an app chooses tier-or-above semantics; absence means exact-tier semantics.

archived.description: Whether this tier is no longer available for new members. Missing means false.

sourceGeneration.description: Optional app-owned monotonic projection generation used to reject stale membership projections.

createdAt.description: When this tier record was created.

updatedAt.description: When this tier record was last updated.

kind.description: Optional app-neutral benefit category. Apps may ignore unknown values.
